question: Why can the knower not be established independently of the known?
premises: The being of the knower is conceived only in relation to the known.
If their mutual form is absent, the relation cannot be established.
If their mutual form is present, independence is still impossible because of incompatibility.
inference: The knower cannot be established independently, since its being depends on the known in every case.
plain_english: The being of the knower and the rest is conceived only from the known; whether their mutual form is absent or present, it cannot stand independently because of their incompatibility.
